notes.title: Update v1.2 Out with important fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

we have just released a new version of aMAZEing adventures which contains several important fixes. Mainly we have fixed some serious crashes and also removed some bugs that were preventing some players to finish some levels in certain situations. Take a look at the patch notes.

Update v1.2
Bugfix: Let me think about it - Gold sphere somitimes did not work correctly
Bugfix: Let me think about it - Doors collison sometimes was blocking the sphere
Bugfix: Help Screen Fixes
Bugfix: Player start points better positioned
Bugfix: General improvements and stability
New: Help Screen Descriptions Added
New: Splash screen particle added


Cheers!
ASC

notes.title: Update v0.8.1 Out now with new Effects and UI elements
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

the latest update to aMAZEing adventures is out and it includes some nice changes. We wanted to improve some UI elements and effects and give players better overview what is going on in maze.

To stay up to date with the dev team make sure to follow our official 
 Twitter account   

Here is a list of some of the changes.

Update v0.8.1
Some 2D elements were replaced with 3D elements
Rumble Controller added for many situations during gameplay
Game over when ball leaves maze added
New sound when picking up health
Counter now shows remaining amount of collectibles needed for finishing level
Particles and efects added when maze is changing - moving walls, traps, doors
Level 17 environment updated with enhanced steampunk ship interior
To grab a maze it is possible to hold grip buttons now

Cheers!
ASC

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27083444/49dcd0bc3403fbeae98e9a6f9264270113a95dd9.jpg

notes.title: Update v0.7.5 released
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Update v0.7.5 is out and includes some cool new things to explore. Make sure you check level 20 where you can see WIP of the upgraded environment and first iteration of new maze.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27083444/830aa662a78fa57cfa6953dfa4ee46cc4e9e47c6.jpg

This update includes:
-Doors and walls now have sound
-In full sail! gameplay redesigned
-Let me think about it level updated with new enviroment and maze
-Steampunk levels environment improved
-New 3D UI elements added for better experience
-Gameplay for Man-O-War shortened
-To finish level you will need to collect certain amount of collectibles in the maze
-Minor bugfixes and general improvements

Cheers,
ASC

notes.title: New Levels, New Mazes, New Adventures
notes.content:
Hello Adventurers,

we are very happy to bring you whole new set of mazes to explore. In the latest aMAZEing adventures update we are releasing 11 new levels. 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27083444/96cf749a05a55e6cf249577806bc7835bd7d9c3a.jpg

You will start where you have left after the fight with the airship. We are now moving on this airship so we can continue. In this new environment there are many new things awaiting. First of all we are introducing steam traps, pipes, switches, golden balls and moving walls. Second there is new type of maze. We call it Verical as it is in front of you and the ball is always falling down. This means you have to be very careful as many times you will have just one shot. Most of the mazes in this new section are even more puzzle oriented. Since we have introduced moving walls you will need to think about how to adjust the maze to allow your ball to reach finish line. Another big addition are pipes. These are meant to move your ball from one location to another. But sometimes this is not exactly what you will be looking for.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27083444/17f80736d7883b831d728a22601a051756b508ee.jpg

Check out the list of new things below and let us know your thoughts.

In upoming days and weeks we will improve this release with more updates.

Cheers!
ASC

 What's new?      

11 new levels to play
Environment inspired by steampunk
New unique mazes including new type of maze - Vertical
Steam traps - will blow away your ball
Switches - triggers with two states
Golden balls - these are here to help you, they are immune to all traps
Pipes - pipes will allow any ball to move to another location within a maze
 

Fixes and improvements: 

Levels now load faster
Ball sounds improved
In-maze doors sounds improved
Exit button added to the level finished screen which will bring you to hub
UI in main menu adjusted and repositioned 
 

Experimental:

Initial support for Oculus and other VR headsets with gamepad - please note not all functionality is supported yet - we are working on this to bring full experience as soon as possible
 

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27083444/ee9be3a4756f7edf7eb67e66dcd90a5e2f9b1385.jpg

As always we would love to hear you ideas and thoughts. Please head to the 
official forums  and let us know.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27083444/553bd7df30e17f4fb14724c822e3b6495531b05c.jpg
